name: Jan Novák
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport marketing began unconventionally, stemming from his early career in consumer electronics. He quickly recognized the crossover appeal of advanced technology and high-performance vehicles, leading him to pursue a role at Mercedes-AMG. He views marketing as a science, meticulously analyzing data and trends to optimize campaign effectiveness. His experience in diverse industries gives him a unique perspective, allowing him to approach challenges with fresh ideas and a practical mindset.

At Mercedes-AMG, Jan is known for his structured and methodical approach to campaign planning. He believes in thorough research and a data-driven strategy. Colleagues admire his commitment to excellence and his ability to adapt to the ever-changing landscape of motorsport marketing. He's not afraid to challenge the status quo, always seeking new and innovative ways to engage fans and promote the brand. Jan’s pragmatic nature ensures that ideas are grounded in reality and aligned with the team's overall goals.

physical.description: Jan is a man of average height with a slightly athletic build, often seen in smart casual attire.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas, even during meetings.
Has a specific brand of Czech coffee he drinks every morning.
Uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversation.
